items.root_cause: the daily chain rewrites the data-bearing tool sources and commits them after check-ad-cycles runs the weekly ghost-drift sweep, and the reconciler refused every dirty page outright, so on every weekly sweep those pages were BLIND, the week was stamped anyway, and a drift the repair lane exists to fix paged instead

root_fix.what: a dirty page is judged against HEAD instead of refused: a republish verdict (live equals an older committed version) publishes HEAD's committed text from a temp copy; save-back and conflict on a dirty page stay BLIND
root_fix.exact_change: new pure Get-TcDirtyPageAction (match->match, republish->publish-head, save-back->blind, conflict->blind, default throws); the live loop sets $dirty instead of continuing, applies the action after the verdict, and on -Apply writes $head to a per-run temp file for publish-tool-post.ps1 -File, removed in finally

prevention.what: the repair lane can now act in the window the daily chain always leaves (sources rewritten, not yet committed), which is the window every weekly sweep runs in
prevention.exact_change: Get-TcDirtyPageAction and its use in the live loop; the uncommitted working tree is never read into Ghost or overwritten
